content: Cloudflare Workers free plan: 3 cron triggers/worker, 10ms CPU per cron tick, no retry on failed scheduled handler, no failure notification, up to 15 min propagation for cron changes, seconds of jitter. Supabase: pg_cron + pg_net invokes edge functions; pg_net is fire-and-forget with ~5000ms connect timeout; auth guidance unclear (service_role static key removed, pgjwt deprecated); JWT verification often disabled on cron-invoked functions. Supabase free tier: project pauses after 7 days of DB inactivity, 500MB DB, 5GB egress, 500K edge invocations, no backups, 402 hard-stop on limit breach.
